sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLIX OF 2001
ORDINANCE XLIX OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
IRRIGATION AND DRAINAGE AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
An.
Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan
Irrigation
and Drainage Authority Act, 1997
[Gazette
of Balochistan, Extraordinary,
7th
November, 2001]
No.Legis.l‑54/Law/$0,
dated 7‑11‑2001.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 3rd‑November, 2001, is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
1. Short
title and commencement. ‑‑‑(1)
This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Irrigation and Drainage Authority
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall
come onto force at once.

dated 7‑11‑2001.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
Governor of Balochistan on 3rd‑November, 2001, is hereby published for

2. Amendment
of section 11 of Act I of 1997.‑‑‑In the Balochistan Irrigation and Drainage Authority Act, 1997,
in-subsection (2) of section 11, for the words "Deputy Commissioner"
the words "Executive District Officer (Revenue)" shall be
substituted.
